question: The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹284 for a period of 2 years at the rate of 5% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total effective interest rate for 2 years = 5% × 2 = 10%

It is given that 10% of Principal = ₹284

⇒ 100% of Principal = 284 × 10 = ₹2840

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2840.**
